data.name: Rashidat
data.gender_notes: Rashidat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rashidat is the feminine form of Rashid, meaning 'rightly guided' in Arabic. It is derived from the Quranic term 'Rashidun' which refers to the first four caliphs of Islam who were known for their righteousness and wisdom. The name Rashidat carries the meaning “Rightly Guided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rashidat usually hope their child will grow to embody rightly guided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be guided on the right path by Allah
data.etymology: Rashidat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rightly Guided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashidat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Rashidat
in_english.meaning: Rashidat means guided on the right path in life
in_english.long_meaning: Rashidat is a feminine name derived from the Arabic verb 'rasha'd', which means to guide or to be on the right path. This name signifies a person who possesses wisdom and insight, guiding them to lead a life of righteousness and truth. In Islamic culture, names like Rashidat are associated with divine guidance and blessings. The name reflects the importance of staying on the path of righteousness and adhering to the principles of justice and morality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rashidat holds a significant place in Islamic history as it is associated with the first four righteous leaders of the Islamic Ummah, also known as the 'Rashidun Caliphs'. This name was given as a mark of honor and respect to those who followed the right path of Islam and implemented its teachings in their leadership. Today, the name Rashidat continues to be a source of inspiration for Muslims, reminding them of the importance of right guidance and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: Rashidat as a name is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality, as it signifies being rightly guided. This reminds us of the ultimate goal of every Muslim - to be guided by Allah, and to follow His commands in every aspect of life. It encourages us to seek knowledge, wisdom, and righteousness, and to strive towards leading a virtuous and pious life. Ultimately, the name Rashidat invites us to draw closer to Allah, and to strive towards doing good deeds, and avoiding the changes that lead us away from His path.
